title: Is Even
description: Write a function that returns True if a number is even, and False if it is odd.
instructions: Implement is_even using the modulo operator to check if a number is divisible by 2.
expected_behavior: is_even(4) → True, is_even(7) → False, is_even(0) → True, is_even(-2) → True.
hints: The modulo operator % gives you the remainder after division.
A number is even if dividing it by 2 leaves no remainder.
4 % 2 == 0 is True, 7 % 2 == 0 is False. What should you return in each case?
